description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Domestic Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) Cylinder unless the weight in Kilograms is marked in a Conspicuous place of such domestic cylinders. This Direction shall become operative with effect from 25th July 2021.
reasoning: This gazette contains a direction issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes a new regulatory requirement for the marking of LPG cylinders, making it a legal/regulatory matter. This falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it involves subsidiary legislation and regulatory compliance requirements, not government personnel or structural changes.
